sources.notes: All-area ANA domestic timetable. Includes ANA marketed flights and operating company codes.
Official JAL domestic timetable for JAL/JTA/RAC; needs a route-query collector.
Japan Air Commuter physical flights that appear in ANA's official all-area timetable are split by operatingCarrier. This is not a full JAL/JAC group timetable.
Official Skymark timetable PDF. Composite [Via ...] displays are skipped so only physical flight legs are emitted.

Official AIRDO route tables. Many ADO flights also appear as ANA-marketed records, so cross-source merge must keep one physical flight. Current collector treats parsed notes as time/customer notices and expands all rows to the published period.

Official Solaseed Air PDF is cached but currently image/table extraction yields no text. Release bundle temporarily derives SNA physical flights from ANA's official all-area timetable by operatingCarrier.
Official StarFlyer route timetable pages. Embedded route rows inside another route page are skipped; many records overlap ANA-marketed SFJ flights.
Official Fuji Dream Airlines route pages. Collector parses 2026 summer tab route tables, skips connection-guide content, and expands marked operating-date notes.
Official IBEX timetable page. The page repeats flights by airport section, so collector dedupes repeated physical rows. All current IBX records overlap ANA-marketed IBX records.

ORC fare page lists official 2026 summer route PDFs, but direct PDF fetch currently returns 403 in automation. Release bundle temporarily derives ORC physical flights from ANA's official all-area timetable by operatingCarrier.
Official AMX public timetable is image-based. Release bundle temporarily derives AMX physical flights from ANA's official all-area timetable by operatingCarrier.
Official Toki Air schedule page. Collector parses published period blocks, Japanese weekday notes, and listed extra operating dates.
Official Peach summer page lists domestic routes and says to check flight search for details; no static full timetable source has been confirmed yet.
Official Jetstar Japan domestic PDF. Physical rows are parsed by PDF column; explicit operation/suspension date notes are expanded, while complex Japanese weekday notes remain flagged.
Official Spring Japan domestic PDF is cached. Physical rows are parsed; several multi-line period/weekday calendars are flagged for a dedicated layout parser.
